programme.title: Boban is Fuigheag
programme.desc: Nuair tha Fuigheag acrach a’ chiad char sa mhadainn, tha e feumach air biadh. Ach ciamar a gheibh e sin ‘s Boban na shuain chadail? When Fuigheag is hungry first thing in the morning, he needs food. But how will he get some with Boban fast asleep?

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc: Tha Sionnach airson ’s gum bi co-là-breith sònraichte aig Maigheach. Tha cuireadh aig Comhachag is Tosg, fhad ’s a bheir iad prèasant brèagha thuice, leithid dìthean le fàileadh cùbhraidh. Chan eil sin cho furasta ’s a shaoileas iad. Fhad ’s a tha iad trang a’ lorg nam prèasantan tha Maigheach air bhioran ’s I a’ feitheamh gus an tòisich am pàrtaidh co-là-breith aice. Fox wants to give Hare the best birthday ever. Owl and Tusk are invited, but only if they bring a nice present, like a beautifully scented flower. But that is not quite as easy as it seems. All the while Hare is kept waiting for her birthday party to start.

programme.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag/Pompon Little Bear
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Pompon 's a phàrantan ag ullachadh 'son turas air falbh, feumaidh Pompon tighinn gu co-dhùnadh air dè tha riatanach a thoirt leis sa bhaga aige. When Pompon and his parents prepare to go on a trip, Pompon must come to a decision as to what is essential for him to take in his bag.

programme.title: Ladybird & Bee/Daolag-bhreac is Seillean
programme.desc: Tha Daolag-bhreac is Seillean ag ionnsachadh dè tha gabhail àite fon talamh – air leth inntinneach! Daolag-bhreac and Seillean are learning what happens underground - really interesting!

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: Tha cuid dhe na rudan as fheàrr le Àtaidh agus Tilidh a dhìth. A bheil cuideigin air an goid? ’S e rùn-dìomhair a th’ ann! Some of Abney and Teal’s favourite objects are missing. Has there been a robbery? It’s a mystery!

programme.title: Dan & Gran
programme.desc: Stan and his friends are at the Ley to do a nature survey but strangely, there doesn't seem to be anything to spot. Where has all the wildlife gone? Tha Dan 's a charaidean aig an Loch gus suirbhidh nàdair a choileanadh, ach gu h-annasach, chan eil dad ann ri amharc. Ach càit' an deach am fiadh-bheatha?

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Gilleasbaig Fearghasdan a’ leughadh Am Prionnsa Cinders. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Babette Cole agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Mòrag Stiùbhart. Gilleasbaig Ferguson reads Am Prionnsa Cinders, written and illustrated by Babette Cole and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart.

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Tha Hilda a’ tionndadh gu leabhar dìomhair airson ionnsachadh mar a chuidicheas i beathannan Dhaibhidh agus a màthair – ach, mo chreach, abair gu ‘eil a coibhneis cosgail is croiseil dhaibh uile. Hilda turns to a mysterious book to learn how she can better the lives of Daibhidh and her mother, but being kind proves to be costly and problematic for all.

programme.title: Stri
programme.desc: Tha preasantairean CBBC ALBA uabhasach fhèin measail air dùbhlain ach saoil cò shoirbhicheas is Fiach a’ tadhal orra? The CBBC ALBA presenters love a good challenge, but who will emerge victorious as Fiach joins them?

programme.title: Geamaichean Gorach
programme.desc: Àm partaidh – ‘s tha na Farpaisich làn plòigh agus gàirdeachais ach chan eil mi smaoineachadh gun còrd an onghail ris na nàbaidhean. Party time, and the competitors are full of fun and joyfulness, but I don’t think that the neighbours will approve of the noise.

programme.title: A-null ’s a-nall
programme.desc: Tha Isra cho toilichte nuair a tha i a’ faighinn an cothrom càmpadh mar a sìnnsearan - na Bedouin - còmhla ri a caraid, Laoise. Isra is delighted when she gets the chance to go camping like her ancestors, the Bedouin, with her friend, Laoise.

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc: Tha na seòid a’ cnuasachadh air biadh a tha math sa gheamhradh agus a’ cruthachadh soithichean eadar-dhealaichte a bheir dhuinn blàths is cofhurtachd. Tha Ruairidh a’ deanamh Stiubha le Càl Dearg agus Feòil-Uain le Sabhsa Mionnt. Tha Ùisdean ag ullachadh Ròst Feòil-Chaorach le crumbail ubhal geamhraidh airson a ghabhail às a dhèidh. Gus crìoch a chur air a’ phrògram, tha Ruairidh ag ullachadh Teatnaidh Biotais agus tha Ùisdean a’ sealltainn dhuinn mar a ni sinn Uisge-beatha air a dhèanamh le smeuran. The lads contemplate winter and come up with a variety of heart-warming comfort foods. Ruairidh cooks red cabbage and a lamb hotpot with mint sauce. Uisdean prepares a mutton chump roast followed by a winter apple crumble. Ruairidh then prepares a beetroot chutney and Uisdean shows us how to make bramble whisky. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Calum Maclean is on the hunt for a world-famous dish which was created in an Indian restaurant in Glasgow.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc: Actress turned interior designer, Erica Macpherson, takes us on a design adventure throughout the Highlands and Islands. With the help of local craft workers she finds new ideas for designing old spaces. Tha an cleasaiche, a tha a-nis na dealbhaiche cruthachail thaighean, Erica Nic a’ Phersain, a’ gabhail sgrìob tron Ghàidhealtachd ‘s na h-Eileanan. Le taic bho luchd-ciùird, tha i a’ lorg dhòighean ùra air seann rumanan a thoirt beò. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Surfing: Marcachd an Tuinn/Riding the Wave
programme.desc: Tha Ceitlin Lilidh a’ toirt thugainn sreath de dhà phàirt air eachdraidh surfadh air feadh an t-saoghail. Ceitlin Lilidh's series on the world history of surfing.

programme.title: Trusadh
programme.desc: Tha Cathy Nicdhòmhnaill a’ bruidhinn ri clann a’ mhansa an là an-diugh. Cathy Macdonald talks to children of the manse.

programme.title: Fonn mo Bheatha
programme.desc: Ceòl agus còmhradh le Cathy Ann Nic a Phi còmhla ri Cairistiona Cheannadach. Music and chat programme presented by Cathy Ann MacPhee with guest Kristine Kennedy.

programme.title: Alleluia!
programme.desc: Prògram sònraichte air DiDòmhnaich Cuimhneachaidh. Salm 124 air a sheinn le Ceòlraidh Ghàidhlig Ghlaschu, an laoidh Nam Aonar le Mo Smuaintinn le Còisir Ghàidhlig Ìleach Ghlaschu agus bidh An t-Urr. Aonghas Mac a' Ghobhainn ag innse mun àite a th' aig creideamh an lùib cogadh is call. Tha am prògram air aithris le Iain MacFhionghain. A special programme for Remembrance Sunday, with Psalm 124 sung by Glasgow Gaelic Choir and the hymn Nam Aonar le mo Smuaintinn by Glasgow Islay Gaelic Choir. Rev Angus Smith describes the part faith plays in war and loss. Presented by Iain MacKinnon.

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Le cuideachadh bho Burtaidh, tha Sif a’ toirt Pipp agus Bran air dàn-chuairt fèill spòrs. Ziff leads Pipp and Button on a fairground adventure with help from faithful Bertie.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha Bèibidh Dràgon Brot’ mì-thoilichte oir chan fhaod e cluich leis an spàin bhrot’ oir tha ro mhòr dha. Gu fortanach, tha Beag a’ moladh gum faod e taic a thoirt dhaibh-san le bhith toirt am brot air ais dhan uamh – is abair g’eil e taiceil! Baby Soup Dragon is unhappy - he isn’t allowed to play with the soup spoon as it’s too big for him. Fortunately, Small suggests that he can help to deliver the soup instead - and he is hugely helpful!

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha bogsa dìomhaireachd air laighe air a’ phlanaid, le rudan annasach na bhroinn - clobhdan a tha nan tuill cuideachd. Tha e comasach dha na Clangairean siubhal tro na tuill seo - agus abair gu bheil iad trang a’ siubhal! A mysterious box has landed on the planet, with curious things inside it - cloths which are also holes. The Clangers can travel through these holes, and they do it a lot!

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha tòrr spòrs aig Peicein is a charaidean a’ cur an ìre gur e ròbotan a th’ annta, gus am brùth cuideigin aca putan is tha an aileag a’ tòiseachadh air Peicein. Carson nach stad an aileag aige? Bheil smachd aig cuideigin air à àiteigin eile? Chan urrainn do Ghriogair sguir a shreothartaich, Lòra a mhèaranaich neo Raghnall a chasadaich. Saoil a bheil iad uile a’ tionndadh nan ròbotan dhà-rìribh? Petit and his friends are having a lot of fun pretending to be robots, until one of them presses a button and Petit gets the hiccups. Why can't he stop hiccupping? Is someone else controlling him from somewhere? Greg can't stop sneezing, Laura yawns and Roman coughs. Could it be that everyone is turning into real life robots?

programme.title: ’S E Iasg a Th’Annam (I’m a Fish)
programme.desc: Tha an t-Iasg Ceann-chaorach gu math lìogach - tha fiaclan orra a dh’itheas cha mhòr rud sam bith agus tha iad math air biathadh nan iasgair a ghoid, gun duine greim fhaighinn orra. The Sheepshead Fish is very sneaky - they can eat pretty much anything as they have very sharp teeth and can steal the bait off fishing hooks, without getting caught.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Mòrag Anna NicNèill a’ leughadh A’ Choinean Chòir. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh le Katie Cotton agus a dhealbhachadh le Blanca Gomez. Chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Mòrag Stiùbhart. A bedtime story for young children. Morag Ann MacNeil reads A’ Choinean Chòir by Katie Cotton, illustrated by Blanca Gomez and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart.

programme.title: Bethany – An Dannsair Gaidhealach/The Highland Dancer
programme.desc: Young Bethany sets herself a daunting challenge - performing the notoriously difficult sword dance, at a major Highland dancing competition in Stornoway.

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Tha Sebastian cho toilicht’ nuair a tha e a’ faighinn seann leabhar-latha beanntan Chaspair – leabhar air leth sònraicht’. Gu mì-fhortanach ge-tà, tha Mgr. Turner ga thoirt bhuaithe, mar pheanas. Ciamar a gheibh e air seo innnse do Chaspair? Sebastian is so happy when he gets Caspar’s old mountain journal, a very special book. Unfortunately, Mr Turner confiscates it as a punishment. How can he tell Caspar about this?

programme.title: A’ Chùil
programme.desc: Tha Choirstaidh air ais le prògram eile bhon stiùidio aice A’ Chùil. Sa phrògram seo bheir i sùil air an neach-ealain ainmeil Hilma Af Klint agus seallaidh i dhut mar a nì thu dealbh anns an stoidhle aicese. Choirstaidh is back with another programme from her studio A’ Chùil. She takes a look at the famous artist Hilma Af Klint, and shows you how to make your own picture in her style.

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Tha Bitzer air fois fhaighinn agus Seonaidh bochd fo gheasaibh aig Mowermouth an Gobhair. Ge-tà leis an treud air fad fo smachd Mowermouth, tha Bitzer a' tuigse gu bheil feum aige air a dheagh charaid. Bitzer gets his wish for some peace and quiet when Shaun becomes hypnotised by Mowermouth the goat and finally stops bothering him. But with the whole flock under the influence of Mowermouth's powerful gaze, Bitzer soon realises just how much he needs his old buddy.

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: Nuair tha Greta an cù a’ cèilidh air an sgoil, tha Flix airson a bhith taiceil dhi. Gu mì-fhortanach tha iad glè mhì-mhodhail nuair a tha ‘ad còmhla. Tha seo ag adhbharachadh trioblaid coin-cait ach the feum air fuasgladh cait-coin. When Greta the dog visits the school, Flix wants to be helpful to her. Unfortunately, they’re very badly behaved when together. This causes a dog-cat problem so what’s needed is a cat-dog solution!

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc: Tha na seòid a’ cnuasachadh air biadh a tha math sa gheamhradh agus a’ cruthachadh soithichean eadar-dhealaichte a bheir dhuinn blàths is cofhurtachd. Tha Ruairidh a’ deanamh Stiubha le Càl Dearg agus Feòil-Uain le Sabhsa Mionnt. Tha Ùisdean ag ullachadh Ròst Feòil-Chaorach le crumbail ubhal geamhraidh airson a ghabhail às a dhèidh. The lads contemplate winter and come up with a variety of heart-warming comfort foods. Ruairidh cooks red cabbage and a lamb hotpot with mint sauce. Uisdean prepares a mutton chump roast followed by a winter apple crumble. Ruairidh then prepares a beetroot chutney and Uisdean shows us how to make bramble whisky. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Claire Macleod from the Isle of Scalpay is Joy’s guest in the studio and Calum Maclean is on the hunt for some important pillars on the Isle of Skye.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Rathad Ramsay
programme.desc: Ramsay meets Kim Carnie on the island of Kerrera, where they walk along picturesque bays with panoramic views of Oban Bay and the Slate Islands. Kim discusses the importance of Gaelic in her life and how that has shaped her career as a singer. She opens up about love and identity, and how that has evolved over the years, whilst enjoying the surrounding nature and fresh autumn air. San treas sreath de Rathad Ramsay bidh Ramsay MacMahon a’ coinneachadh ri sàr Ghàidheil bho air feadh Alba ‘s iad a’ co-roinn sgeulachdan, cuir luach air nàdar agus a’ cnuasachadh ma beatha. Tha Ramsay a’ coinneachadh ri Kim Carnie air eilean Chearrara far a bheil iad air an cuartachadh le bàghean àlainn agus seallaidhean air leth den Òban agus na h-Eileanan Sglèata. Innsidh Kim cho cudromach ‘s a tha Gàidhlig na beatha ‘s a bhuaidh a tha seo air a thoirt air a beatha agus air a dreuchd na seinneadair. Gu follaiseach dèidheil air àm an fhoghair agus an àrainneachd ghlan mun cuairt, tha i fuasgladh suas ma beachdan air gaol, fèin-aithne agus mar a tha sin air obrachadh a-mach na beatha fhèin. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Am Balla (The Wall)
programme.desc: Tha Ramsay MacMahon a’ dol air turas gus ionnsachadh mun sgaradh mòr eadar beartas agus bochdainn ann an São Paulo, Braisil. Bho na coimhearsnachdan beartach glaiste air cùl gheataichean tèarainteachd gu na favelas a tha a’ cuir thairis le sluagh, tha ballachan do-fhaicsinneach a’ sgaradh dhaoine bho chèile sa bhaile seo. Air an turas aige, cluinnidh Ramsay bho dhaoine a tha feuchainn ris an sgaradh seo a thoirt às a chèile le bhith a’ cruthachadh chothroman do dhaoine ann an cuid de na coimhearsnachdan far a bheil an ana-chothrom as motha ri fhaicinn. Ramsay MacMahon goes on a journey to find out about the deep divide between wealth and poverty in São Paulo, Brazil. From the affluent gated communities to the overcrowded favelas, invisible walls separate people in this city. On his journey, Ramsay hears from individuals who are determined to break down division by creating opportunities for people within some of the city's most disadvantaged communities. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Binneas - Na Trads
programme.desc: Am buannaiche dhuaisean Calum McIlroy agus còmhlan-ciùil aig Duaisean nan Trads 2024. Anns an t-seata, Strathspeys & Reel, The Banks of Newfoundland agus Polonessa Spoof. Award-winning musician Calum McIlroy and band, recorded at the 2024 Trad Awards. The set includes Strathspeys & Reel, The Banks of Newfoundland and Polonessa Spoof.

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: Shetland’s expansive coastline is home to endless towering cliffs, but its remoteness from the mainland means they see few ascents. With a friend in tow, Coinneach Rankin travels to Shetland in search of new routes and spectacular climbing challenges. Tha oirthir fhada Shealtainn loma làn chreagan tomadach agus seallaidhean nach creidear, ach air sgàth cho cèin ’s a tha i bho thir-mòr, chan fhaigh cus an cothrom sreap ann. Le seann charaid na chuideachd, siubhailidh Coinneach MacFhraing a Shealtainn air tòir slighean ùra is dùbhlain bharraichte. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Ath-thogail Notre-Dame/Rebuilding Notre-Dame
programme.desc: In the fire, Notre-Dame cathedral lost its light and soul - researchers are working to restore the many things that perished.

programme.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
programme.desc: Skipinnish le Alive ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a’ comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform Alive in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle.

programme.title: An Clo Mor
programme.desc: The arrival of potential Norwegian investor Johan throws a cat among the pigeons as age old family secrets and resentments come to the fore. The MacSween clan soon begin to realise that the mill is in worse shape than they thought and Seumas makes a surprise announcement to save the mill. Tha ruighinn, an neach-tasgaidh Nirribheach Johan a’ cur a' chiùil air feadh na fìdhle. Tha rùintean-dìomhair agus seann nàimhdeas an teaghlaich a’ togail ceann aon uair eile. Chan eil e a’ toirt fad sam bith mus tuig teaghlach MhicSuain gu bheil a’ mhuileann ann an staid fada nas miosa na bha iad an dùil agus tha a’ bheachd a th’ aig Seumas airson a’ mhuileann a shàbhaileadh a’ cur iongnadh orra uile. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Sula a’ tadhal air Bing ‘s i air a h-aodann a pheantadh mar dhealan-dè, tha i airson aodann Bing a’ pheantadh cuideachd. Chaneil am peantadh a' dol ro mhath ach tha e sealbhach gu bheil Flop ri làimh airson gnothaichean a rèiteachadh. When Sula visits Bing with her face painted like a butterfly, she also wants to face paint Bing. But the painting doesn’t go well for them. Fortunately, Flop is on hand to sort it all out.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Tha Bing brònach nuair a thèid innse dha, an-dèidh dha a’ bhanachdach fhaighinn, nach eil gin de na steigearan sònraichte as fheàrr leis air fhàgail. Tha cùisean ag atharrachadh ge-tà nuair a tha e a’ faighinn teisteanas grinn, sònraichte. Bing is sad when he is told, after having had his vaccination, that there are none of his favourite stickers left at Dr Molly’s surgery. He soon cheers up though when he is given a very special certificate instead.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Tha na h-Abadas air bothan a dhèanamh anns an taigh agus a' faighinn tòrr spòrs bho bhith cluich anns an uisge. Tha facal an là-an-diugh co-cheangailte ri cumail tioram, cuideachd. Dè th'ann agus càite an lorg iad e? The Abadas have made a den inside the house and are having a lot of fun playing in the rain. Today's word has something to do with keeping dry, too. What could it be and where will they find it?

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: Tha cuid dhe na rudan as fheàrr le Àtaidh agus Tilidh a dhìth. A bheil cuideigin air an goid? ’S e rùn-dìomhair a th’ ann! Some of Abney and Teal’s favourite objects are missing. Has there been a robbery? It’s a mystery!

programme.title: ’S E Iasg a Th’Annam (I’m a Fish)
programme.desc: Tha an t-Iasg Ceann-chaorach gu math lìogach - tha fiaclan orra a dh’itheas cha mhòr rud sam bith agus tha iad math air biathadh nan iasgair a ghoid, gun duine greim fhaighinn orra. The Sheepshead Fish is very sneaky - they can eat pretty much anything as they have very sharp teeth and can steal the bait off fishing hooks, without getting caught.

programme.title: Peataichean/Pets
programme.desc: Tha Eilidh NicCarmaig a’ coinneachadh ri clann agus a’ faighinn a-mach mu mar a tha iad a’ coimhead às dèidh agus a’ cluich cuide rim peataichean aig an taigh. Anns a’ phrògram seo tha Eilidh a’ cèilidh air Angus agus na ceithir cait spòrsail aige. Gheibh sinn a-mach barrachd mu bhith a’ coimhead às dèidh cait agus mu na rudan snog is spòrsail a bhios Angus, Parlsey, Jasper, Roxy agus Dylan a’ dèanamh còmhla. Gheibh sinn cuideachd comhairle agus fiosrachadh bho Eilidh fhèin mu bhith a’ làimhseachadh, ag oideachadh agus a’ coimhead às dèidh peataichean. Eilidh Cormack meets young children who are pet owners. Together they show, tell and share how they care for, play and interact with their pets at home. In this episode, Eilidh visits Angus and his four handsome and fun-loving cats. We find out how to look after cats and about all the lovely stuff Angus, Jasper, Parsley, Roxy and Dylan get up to together. Eilidh also shares fun and interesting facts along with advice on looking after pets at home - including how best to handle, train and feed them.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Iain MacAonghais a’ leughadh Air Cnoc Grad. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh le Linda Sarah agus a dhealbhachadh le Benji Davies. Chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Jo NicDhòmhnaill. A bedtime story for young children. Iain MacInnes reads Air Cnoc Grad by Linda Sarah, illustrated by Benji Davies and translated into Gaelic by Jo Macdonald.

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Tha Sona air a bhith trang a’ fàsgadh dhearcan ach tha e air cus den t-sùgh òl – tha sin ga fhàgail nas beòthail’ ‘s nas toilicht’ na bha e o chionn fhada. Abair gu bheil deagh ghumbladh a’ gabhail àit’! Sona has been busy pulping berries but he’s drunk too much of the juice - this has made him livelier and happier than he’s been for quite a while. There’s a lot of Gumbling taking place!

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Tha an dithis mhealltair – Merri is Seonaidh – ri miastadh. Nuair a tha ’ad a' toirt seachad gheallaidhean nach meall ’ad na Gumbalan, tha ’ad a' tionndadh gus feuchainn ris a’ char a thoirt às na Bògaisean. Saoil ciamar a thèid dhaibh? The two tricksters, Merri and Seonaidh, are up to no good. When they promise not to trick the Gumbals, they turn to playing mischief on the Bògaisean. How will they get on?

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Tha Bitzer air fois fhaighinn agus Seonaidh bochd fo gheasaibh aig Mowermouth an Gobhair. Ge-tà leis an treud air fad fo smachd Mowermouth, tha Bitzer a' tuigse gu bheil feum aige air a dheagh charaid. Bitzer gets his wish for some peace and quiet when Shaun becomes hypnotised by Mowermouth the goat and finally stops bothering him. But with the whole flock under the influence of Mowermouth's powerful gaze, Bitzer soon realises just how much he needs his old buddy.

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Tha Hilda a’ tionndadh gu leabhar dìomhair airson ionnsachadh mar a chuidicheas i beathannan Dhaibhidh agus a màthair – ach, mo chreach, abair gu ‘eil a coibhneis cosgail is croiseil dhaibh uile. Hilda turns to a mysterious book to learn how she can better the lives of Daibhidh and her mother, but being kind proves to be costly and problematic for all.

programme.title: Fillte
programme.desc: Fillte travels throughout Scotland, visiting the country’s finest woven craft producers. Tha Fillte a siuhbail fad Alba a lorg an obair-laimhne is fhearr, sa luchd-ciùird fighe a chruthaich e.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Tòmas MacAilpein is Joy’s studio guest, and Calum Maclean is on a historical trail as he introduces us to the story of the heroic Vatersay Raiders.

programme.title: Cidsin Granaidh Chalanais
programme.desc: Gregor makes his grannie’s gingerbread and classic Scottish tablet, and adds his own flair to her fishcake recipe.

programme.title: Ro Thrath don t-Saoghal/Born too Soon
programme.desc: Obair sgioba an Aonad Dlùth-chùram Leanabain ’s iad a’ coimhead an dèidh naoidheanan so-leònta. The work of the NICU team and their care for vulnerable babies.

programme.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
programme.desc: Skipinnish le Land Below the Waves ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a’ comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform Land Below the Waves in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: A chocolate babka is a feast for the eyes as well as the belly! It's a popular dish in Poland and the Ukraine. Tha babka teòclaid taitneach, an dà chuid dhan bhrù agus dhan t-sùil! Tha fèill air anns a' Phòlaind agus anns a' Ucràin. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Glan Fhèin
programme.desc: A mockumentary shadowing a company that services short term lets. Angela and Katie aim to clean-up and give the competition a bleaching. Blockages need to be dealt with, not just unclogging hot tub filters. A new staff member has a few skeletons in his cupboard but ex-con Daniel hopes he has a squeaky-clean future. Meanwhile, Betty meets Daniel’s pregnant partner Dido and checks in on her beloved pet pooch Buster. Soon the police are knocking on the company’s portacabin door. Written by and starring Hannah McKirdy and Lana Pheutan.

programme.title: Sar Sgeoil
programme.desc: Cathy Macdonald on Bram Stoker’s iconic horror novel, Dracula. Cathy Dhòmhnallach air an leabhar ainmeil oillte aig Bram Stoker, Dracula.

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: Shetland’s expansive coastline is home to endless towering cliffs, but its remoteness from the mainland means they see few ascents. With a friend in tow, Coinneach Rankin travels to Shetland in search of new routes and spectacular climbing challenges. Tha oirthir fhada Shealtainn loma làn chreagan tomadach agus seallaidhean nach creidear, ach air sgàth cho cèin ’s a tha i bho thir-mòr, chan fhaigh cus an cothrom sreap ann. Le seann charaid na chuideachd, siubhailidh Coinneach MacFhraing a Shealtainn air tòir slighean ùra is dùbhlain bharraichte. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Tha na h-Abadas air bothan a dhèanamh anns an taigh agus a' faighinn tòrr spòrs bho bhith cluich anns an uisge. Tha facal an là-an-diugh co-cheangailte ri cumail tioram, cuideachd. Dè th'ann agus càite an lorg iad e? The Abadas have made a den inside the house and are having a lot of fun playing in the rain. Today's word has something to do with keeping dry, too. What could it be and where will they find it?

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Le cuideachadh bho Burtaidh, tha Sif a’ toirt Pipp agus Bran air dàn-chuairt fèill spòrs. Ziff leads Pipp and Button on a fairground adventure with help from faithful Bertie.

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha a’ ghrian a’ deàrrsadh ‘s tha Ooona'son dhol a dh’iasgach. Tha May ag aontachadh cluich cuide ri Baba ach tha Baba a’ diùltadh faiche nan gràineag fhàgail gus an dùisg Spiky bho chadal-geamhraidh! It’s a beautiful day and Oona wants to practise fishing. May offers to play with Baba, who refuses to leave the hedghog burrow as he wants to wait until Spiky wakes from his hibernation!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Oona daonnan ann an cabhag ach tha Papa airson sealltainn dhi gum bi buthaidean a' gabhail cùisean air an socair. Saoil an tig aice air ionnsachadh rudan a dhèanamh ann an ‘Dòigh na Buthaide? Oona is forever in a hurry to learn and get things done, but Papa wants to show her that puffins tend to approach things in a slow and steady fashion. Will Oona master the ‘Way of the Puffin?’

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha Bèibidh Dràgon Brot’ mì-thoilichte oir chan fhaod e cluich leis an spàin bhrot’ oir tha ro mhòr dha. Gu fortanach, tha Beag a’ moladh gum faod e taic a thoirt dhaibh-san le bhith toirt am brot air ais dhan uamh – is abair g’eil e taiceil! Baby Soup Dragon is unhappy - he isn’t allowed to play with the soup spoon as it’s too big for him. Fortunately, Small suggests that he can help to deliver the soup instead - and he is hugely helpful!

programme.title: Peataichean/Pets
programme.desc: Tha Eilidh NicCarmaig a’ coinneachadh ri clann agus a’ faighinn a-mach mu mar a tha iad a’ coimhead às dèidh agus a’ cluich cuide rim peataichean aig an taigh. Anns a’ phrògram seo tha Eilidh a’ cèilidh air Angus agus na ceithir cait spòrsail aige. Gheibh sinn a-mach barrachd mu bhith a’ coimhead às dèidh cait agus mu na rudan snog is spòrsail a bhios Angus, Parlsey, Jasper, Roxy agus Dylan a’ dèanamh còmhla. Gheibh sinn cuideachd comhairle agus fiosrachadh bho Eilidh fhèin mu bhith a’ làimhseachadh, ag oideachadh agus a’ coimhead às dèidh peataichean. Eilidh Cormack meets young children who are pet owners. Together they show, tell and share how they care for, play and interact with their pets at home. In this episode, Eilidh visits Angus and his four handsome and fun-loving cats. We find out how to look after cats and about all the lovely stuff Angus, Jasper, Parsley, Roxy and Dylan get up to together. Eilidh also shares fun and interesting facts along with advice on looking after pets at home - including how best to handle, train and feed them.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Angela NicAoidh a’ leughadh Air Mo Shlighe Dhan Amar. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh le Sarah Maizes agus a dhealbhachadh le Michael Paraskevas. Chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Jo NicDhòmhnaill. A bedtime story for young children. Angela Mackay reads Air Mo Shlighe Dhan Amar by Sarah Maizes, illustrated by Michael Paraskevas and translated into Gaelic by Jo Macdonald.

programme.title: SpongeBob
programme.desc: Heat-loving hippies move into Mr Krabs' soup vat! Tha sgioba an tòir air blàths a’ lorg dachaigh anns a’ bhrot aig Mgr. Crùbag.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Tha sgrudaire sgoile air nochdadh aig Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche agus chan eil Maighstir Mackle neo na tidsearan deiseil air a shon. Chan eil cùisean a’ coimhead ro mhath do Mhaighstir MhicFhraing ach tha Maighstir Strachan air a chasan, neo co-dhiù aona chois a lorg. Dè as urrainn a dhol ceàrr?! There’s a surprise visit from a school inspector at Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche. It’s not looking good for Mr MacFhraing, although Mr Strachan seems to have found his feet, well one foot at least. What could possibly go wrong?!

programme.title: Bethany – An Dannsair Gaidhealach/The Highland Dancer
programme.desc: Young Bethany sets herself a daunting challenge - performing the notoriously difficult sword dance, at a major Highland dancing competition in Stornoway.

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Tha rèis dhan bhàrr dol bhith ann – a’ chiad oileanach a chuireas flaga air Beinn Rocaid a' buinnig na duais. Ach bheil cuideigin na chealgaire? A race to the summit is going to take place - the first student to plant a flag on Mount Rocket will win the trophy. But is somebody a cheat?

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Tha Bitzer air crìoch a chuir air an obair-taighe gu lèir agus a-nis chan eil càil aige ri dhèanamh. The e air a dhòigh nuair a mhothachas e gu bheil an t-sabhal feumach air sgioblachadh - gus an tig e tairsinn air dealbh nach gabh a chrochadh gu dìreach! Bitzer has completed all his chores and is at a bit of a loss. He's delighted when he discovers the flock's barn needs a good tidy-up, until he comes across a wonky picture that just won't hang straight.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: An greimean lòin as fheàrr le Abigail, 's e Buntàta Cruasbach Sàiste. 'Ad cho blast' 's a tha 'ad rin ithe. Tha 'n seòrs' aice-se soirbh a dhèanamh; feumaidh tu fheuchainn. Abigail’s favourite snack lunch is crispy sage potatoes. It's as nice to look at as to eat and her version is easy to make - you must try it! In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Fonn mo Bheatha
programme.desc: Ceòl agus còmhradh le Cathy Ann Nic a Phi còmhla ri Cairistiona Cheannadach. Music and chat programme presented by Cathy Ann MacPhee with guest Kristine Kennedy.

programme.title: Gàrraidhean Mòra na h-Alba
programme.desc: Murdo Macdonald explores the Japanese Garden at Cowden. Murchadh Dòmhnallach a’cur eòlas air Gàrradh Siapanach Cowden faisg air Dollar.

programme.title: Mas Fhior
programme.desc: Farpais-cheist do-chreidsinneach... Mas Fhìor! Le ochdnar Mas Fhìoraich a’ cluich bhon dachaighean fhèin, ’s iad an fheadhainn a chuireas na ceistean agus na freagairtean. An urrainn do Isla is Hamish agus Jamie is Liam a tha a’ cluich bhon stiùideo a’ chùis a dhèanamh orra airson an duais mhòr a bhuannachadh? A quiz show that is pretty unbelievable! Eight Pretenders play from the comfort of their own homes and hold all the questions and answers to this quiz. Can Isla and Hamish, or Jamie and Liam in the studio beat the Pretenders for a chance to win a cash prize? In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Steelmen
programme.desc: Ann an 1991, bha baile Thobar na Màthar a’ greimeachadh ris a’ bhuaidh shòisealta, eaconamach agus chultarail a bheireadh dùnadh ionad stàilinn Ravenscraig air an sgìre, ach airson a’ chiad uair ann an 39 bliadhna thog sgioba ball-coise a’ bhaile, na ‘Steelmen' mar a theirear riutha, Cupa na h-Alba, a’ toirt boillsgeadh dòchais a thogadh an dorchadas. In 1991, as the town of Motherwell faced the crippling social, economic and cultural impact of the closure of the Ravenscraig steelworks, its football club, locally known as the Steelmen, lifted the prestigious Scottish Cup for the first time in 39 years. The victory was a glimmer of light in the ensuing darkness.

programme.title: Ciad-fàthan nan Creutairean/Wild Senses
programme.desc: We explore the surprising ways animals use touch to sense their world, find food and stay out of danger.

programme.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
programme.desc: Skipinnish le The Island ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a’ comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform The Island in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Prògram de cheòl traidiseanta agus freumhach air a lìbhrigeadh le Màiri Anna NicUalraig. Air fhilmeadh aig àm Celtic Connections 2024 agus a’ taisbeanaidh chlàraidhean is chòmhraidhean a chaidh a dhèanamh a dh’aona ghothach airson Seirm, chìte cuid den luchd-ciùil a b’ fheàrr a bha aig an fhèis, leithid Kathryn Tickell & The Darkening, Eòghann MacEunraig, Genticorum, TEUD & Kaïa Kater. Traditional and roots music show presented by Mary Ann Kennedy. Filmed during Celtic Connections 2024, Seirm showcases bespoke recordings and conversations with some of the best artists appearing at the festival. This episode features performances from Kathryn Tickell & The Darkening, Ewen Henderson, Genticorum and intimate session recordings with TEUD & Kaïa Kater. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.desc: Janina Ramirez and Alastair Sooke discover Barcelona through its art and architecture, including the frescoes that inspired Miro and a surprising collection of vintage fans.

programme.title: Alaska: Earth's Frozen Kingdom
programme.desc: Three-part series that looks at a year in Alaska, revealing the stories of pioneering Alaskans, both animal and human, as they battle the elements and reap the benefits of nature's seasonal gold rush.

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Magnificent Monuments
programme.desc: Steeplejack Fred Dibnah considers the development of castles, from early Iron Age forts to secret underground tunnels used during the Second World War. At Hadrian's Wall, he marvels at the design of Roman toilets, while in Warwick, he joins a band of medieval knights to test the castle's defences.

programme.title: War Walks
programme.desc: A journey through six centuries of warfare in the company of military historian Professor Richard Holmes. In 1415, Henry V won a remarkable victory against a French force that outnumbered him by five to one. Professor Holmes retraces Henry's route to Agincourt and finds a story of heroism and brutality.

programme.title: To the Manor Born
programme.desc: Stately sitcom. A repair bill for Audrey's Rolls-Royce finally convinces her to revert to four-legged horsepower.

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: Sitcom. When Hyacinth hears that Emmet is rehearsing a musical, she is beside herself. Unfortunately sorting out Daddy's antics has to take priority.

programme.title: The Stuarts
programme.desc: Presented by Dr Clare Jackson of Cambridge University, this three-part series argues the Stuarts, more than any other, were Britain's defining royal family. We tend to take today's modern United Kingdom for granted, but there was nothing inevitable about its creation. During the 17th century, the Stuarts grappled with the chaos of three separate Kingdoms, multiple religions and civil war. Britain has not known a century like it and some of the questions this dynasty faced have not gone away. In the opening episode, Clare looks at James VI and I's attempts to unite Scotland and England under the umbrella of his crowns and persuade his subjects to feel more 'British'.

programme.title: Storyville
programme.desc: Manhood follows Dallas businessman Bill Moore as he sets out to make penis enlargement as commonplace as Botox and bring these procedures into the mainstream, positioning male cosmetic surgery as a growing part of the aesthetics industry. The film follows several men, including a gay porn star and a father of five, as they both put their bodies on the line and undergo procedures in pursuit of physical transformation. Through intimate access to both the practitioners selling the dream and the men buying into it, the film traces the insecurities, trauma and societal pressures driving each of them, while raising uncomfortable questions about the ethics of an industry built on male self-doubt. Filmed over two years, with dark humour and unexpected tenderness, Manhood is a timely and revealing portrait of identity and self-image as cosmetic surgery among men continues to rise.

programme.title: Secrets of Size: Atoms to Supergalaxies
programme.desc: In the concluding episode of the series, Jim encounters ever larger cosmic structures to reveal the latest breakthroughs in our understanding of the universe. For example, there’s the heliosphere, a vast cloud of solar plasma that surrounds and protects the solar system. Its unique physics help us understand why life is possible. Larger still, Jim comes face to face with our galactic home the Milky Way, a monstrous structure sculpted by the gravitational forces of dark matter. Jim finds out from pioneering researcher Adrian Fabian about the black hole at its centre, whose strange behaviour includes emitting the lowest note that can be heard in the cosmos. At an even greater scale, Jim encounters huge structures such as the Laniakea Supercluster, of which the Milky Way is only a tiny part. Then there’s 'the giant arc', a collection of galaxies that account for more than three per cent of the observable universe. Jim learns from its discoverer, British PhD student Alexia Lopez, that this gargantuan structure is forcing scientists to reassess their theory of how the universe evolves and may overturn some of the most fundamental principles in physics.

programme.title: Remembers...
programme.desc: One of Britain's most acclaimed and respected directors, Ken Loach, is the man behind award-winning films like The Wind that Shakes the Barley, Land and Freedom and I, Daniel Blake - but in terms of impact, his most important piece will for many always be the BBC's 1966 television drama Cathy Come Home. Written by Jeremy Sandford, produced by Tony Garnett and with Carol White in the titular role, Cathy's look at the plight of Britain's homeless left viewers shocked and forced the nation to confront an issue that until then had largely been ignored. Here, Ken looks back on the experiences of making the film, and shares his insights into the reactions it generated. Critics like Mary Whitehouse attacked him and the BBC for abandoning impartiality and brainwashing the public, while others applauded a groundbreaking and important piece of campaigning drama.

programme.title: The Wednesday Play
programme.desc: Landmark 1960s TV play about a young couple and their children who are cruelly overtaken by events which lead them into an unrelenting trap of debt, homelessness and poverty.

programme.title: In Conversation
programme.desc: Actor Cillian Murphy, who played the lead role in Ken Loach's Palme d'Or-winning film The Wind That Shakes the Barley, talks to the director at the BFI Southbank about a prolific career dedicated to documenting social and political injustice, the importance of artistic collaboration, the often-overlooked humour in Loach's films, and the impact working with Loach had on his own approach to acting.

programme.title: The Battle of the River Plate
programme.desc: Second World War naval adventure based on the true story of the pursuit of the seemingly unstoppable German battleship Graf Spee. programme.title: Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy
programme.desc: Film adaptation of John Le Carre's Cold War novel about a retired MI6 agent who must track down a Soviet mole within the British intelligence service's ranks.

programme.title: Mark Kermode's Secrets of Cinema
programme.desc: Mark Kermode explores one of the most distinctive and popular genres of all. The spy movie plays on our paranoia and feeds our fears as well as fulfilling our fantasies of secret missions and special skills. It has also given us perhaps the most famous hero in all of cinema – James Bond. Spy movies capture a world not of black and white but shades of grey. But if the morality is often ambiguous, the genre is full of tried and tested conventions. Mark opens up the cinematic agent’s essential toolkit, from the spy boss to the mysterious McGuffin, surveillance techniques to a striking set of opening titles, and he traces the development of the genre from its earliest days. Whether you’re a blockbuster superspy or a compromised cold warrior, Mark reveals all you need to survive in the murky yet thrilling world of big screen espionage.

programme.title: In Conversation
programme.desc: Actor Cillian Murphy, who played the lead role in Ken Loach's Palme d'Or-winning film The Wind That Shakes the Barley, talks to the director at the BFI Southbank about a prolific career dedicated to documenting social and political injustice, the importance of artistic collaboration, the often-overlooked humour in Loach's films, and the impact working with Loach had on his own approach to acting.

programme.title: Timeshift
programme.desc: What happens when a literary novelist tries to write popular romantic fiction? To mark 100 years of romance publishers Mills and Boon, literary novelist Stella Duffy takes on the challenge of writing for them. Romantic fiction is a global phenomenon, and Mills and Boon are among the biggest names in the business. The company welcomes submissions from new authors, but as Duffy soon finds out, writing a Mills and Boon is harder than it looks. Help is at hand from the publishers themselves, a prolific Mills and Boon author and some avid romance fans, as Duffy's quest to create the perfect romantic novel takes her from London to Italy on a journey that is both an insight into the art of romantic fiction and the joy and frustration of writing itself.

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Magnificent Monuments
programme.desc: Steeplejack Fred Dibnah tours Britain admiring some of its engineering marvels. This edition takes in Preston, County Durham, St Paul's Cathedral and York Minster.

programme.title: War Walks
programme.desc: The British troops who marched against the Germans in August 1914 believed the war would be over by Christmas. But at Mons they learned that the old world of swords and bugles would be swept away by the machine gun and the shell. Richard Holmes follows in their footsteps as they retreated south from Mons.

programme.title: Girls in Bands at the BBC
programme.desc: Compilation celebrating some guitar band performances at the BBC that feature some of the best female musicians in rock. Beginning with the oft-forgotten American group Fanny performing You're the One, it's a journey along rock's spectrum from the 1970s to now. The selection includes the powerful vocals of Elkie Brooks on Vinegar Joe's Proud to Be a Honky Woman, the mesmerising poetry of Patti Smith's Horses and the upbeat energy of The Go-Go's on We Got the Beat. Mighty basslines come courtesy of Tina Weymouth on Psycho Killer and Kim Gordon on Sugar Kane, whilst we trace the line of indie rock from the Au Pairs through Lush, Elastica and Garbage to current band Savages.

programme.title: Talking Business
programme.desc: Can Africa hold on to more of the wealth its metals and minerals are creating? Amid the rise of electric cars, data centres and the ‘electrification of everything’, a growing number of countries across the continent are putting restrictions on their raw materials. The Democratic Republic of Congo, Ghana and Zimbabwe are amongst those want to keep more of the jobs and prosperity they bring at home, but what will it take to succeed? The CEO of the International Council on Mining and Metals, Rohitesh Dhawan, warns there could be a chilling effect on new investments if the rules keep changing. However the African Development Bank’s chief economist, Kevin Urama, says Africa needs the jobs for its young people and that could benefit the rest of the world too. Plus, Ben Thompson hears from the CEO of Hitachi Energy, Andreas Schierenbeck, about exactly where the demand for electricity is coming from.

programme.title: AI Decoded
programme.desc: Would you let AI walk around your home? We explore the growing race to put humanoid robots into our homes and workplaces. We examine Meta's reported robot project, the rise of Chinese robot manufacturers, the privacy risks of machines that can see, hear and map our lives and whether robots are becoming Big Tech's next multi-trillion-dollar bet. Meta has reportedly built a humanoid robot called Max and, if Mark Zuckerberg gets his way, this could be the next frontier for artificial intelligence. After years of AI living on our screens, Silicon Valley is now racing to give AI a body, one that can see, hear, move through the world and interact with people in real life. Could a humanoid robot really become as common as a smartphone? Would you trust one to help around the house, care for an elderly relative, or perform tasks at work? And as companies spend hundreds of billions of dollars on AI, are robots the breakthrough the industry has been waiting for, or another expensive gamble destined to disappoint?

One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Life on the Bay
programme.desc: It’s a glorious summer in Fife, and one of the park’s longest-serving staff, Billy, is preparing for a unique challenge - a skydive to mark his 80th birthday. The whole team is pulling together to plan a secret surprise celebration for Billy as he builds up to the big jump. Meanwhile, it’s all change in the restaurant kitchens as the head chef, James, plans a complete overhaul of the park’s menus. And a young family new to the park enjoy summer fun at the beach.

programme.title: Scotland’s Sacred Islands with Ben Fogle
programme.desc: Arriving on the Isle of Barra, Ben discovers how his own hand-knitted Gansey fisherman’s jumper is inspired by the hazardous life on these islands. We find Ben aboard a fishing boat in a wild sea, heading for the remote and deserted Mingulay – the Isle of Whispering Ghosts. He learns how the extremes of life here forced the community to abandon it. Travelling across a causeway, Ben reaches South Uist and joins Paul McCallum - the Singing Crofter, who composes Gaelic hymns, singing them as he works. He believes that faith, work and song all go together. Journeying north, Ben finds the island’s iconic 30ft Our Lady of the Isles statue, which overlooks a Nato missile base to remind the military that a greater power watches them. Prince Charles came to the Hebrides for a week in 1987 to escape media scrutiny. No-one leaked his presence to the press, and Ben drops in for morning tea with the prince’s host, 90-year-old Gloria MacKillop, to learn the art of keeping a secret. Ben then camps down for the night on Hosta Beach to reflect on this stage of his pilgrimage and what he has gained from it.

programme.title: Paramedics on Scene
programme.desc: Paramedics in Perth respond to a 999 call for Emily, a 13-year-old who has been injured during rugby practice at school, suffering a suspected broken arm and dislocated shoulder. The team now face the delicate and potentially dangerous task of moving her to the ambulance. Meanwhile, at the Inverness Ambulance Control Centre, Jackie organises help for a young teenager who is unresponsive after drinking eight cans of lager and a bottle of vodka, while Chloe speaks to a distressed bystander who has witnessed a severe motorcycle accident. Paramedic Stephen is part of the ambulance team on board the King Air. The team respond to incidents spanning the length and breadth of the country, and today he is helping to transport a patient from the island community of Stornoway to the specialist cardiac unit at Glasgow’s Golden Jubilee Hospital. In Glasgow’s Southside, David and Chanda have their first shift together as they treat an elderly cancer patient who is suffering from a possible infection. They also respond to a concerning call from a woman who has reported heavy bleeding and then abruptly hung up without leaving a full address.

programme.title: Mythland
programme.desc: On the Isle of Skye, fairy tales are more than just stories. From magical pools promising eternal youth, to ancient bridges said to connect our world with the supernatural, the island’s fairy folklore draws thousands of curious visitors every year. But is it all a clever tourist trap, or does something deeper lie behind the legends? In this enchanting adventure, sceptic Zara joins folklore enthusiast Evelyn to investigate the mysteries of Skye’s fairy tradition. At the heart of their journey is Dunvegan Castle’s legendary Fairy Flag, an ancient relic said to have been gifted by a fairy and to hold the power to protect the MacLeod clan in battle. As they uncover dramatic tales of clan warfare, explore Gaelic songs and hear extraordinary stories passed down through generations, Evelyn and Zara discover a tradition woven into the island’s history, identity and culture. Could there be more to the fairies of Skye than meets the eye? And will the promise of eternal youth finally tempt Zara to believe in a little magic?

programme.title: Mythland
programme.desc: Was Mary Queen of Scots responsible for her husband’s murder, or was she the victim of a ruthless plot to destroy her? Evelyn and Zara embark on a royal murder mystery to uncover the truth behind one of Scotland’s most infamous queens. From the shocking death of Lord Darnley to the mysterious Casket Letters, they follow a trail of scandal, suspicion and political intrigue, meeting historians who reveal the secrets behind the story. With affairs, betrayal and power-hungry nobles at every turn, the evidence raises serious questions about who really wanted Darnley dead. Was Mary a murderer, or was she framed by those determined to control her? As her story unfolds, a woman’s fight for power becomes a battle for her reputation, and the legacy she left behind.

They sample delights in the coastal town of Eyemouth, including a stay in a mansion built for a notorious smuggler. They travel to Kelso for some R&R in a beautifully restored 12th-century manor, before heading to Newcastleton to check out the local agricultural show and stay in an off-grid alpine chalet.

programme.desc: Khalil never remembers his dates’ names, so he calls them all 'baby girl' to skirt around it. Obsessed with looking good, he checks himself out in the reflection of a spoon every 20 minutes on dinner dates and thinks it’s impressive to tell boastful, drunken stories. No wonder the ladies don’t come back for a second date! Cavan is fed up of his best mate Khalil’s dating fails and Khalil not listening to his advice, so he calls on the help of Gen Z's most trusted sex and relationships expert, Oloni, to put this 21-year-old Notts boy on the spot and get him to own up to his bad dating habits. Khalil and Oloni watch video feedback from some very honest friends and exes to show him first hand where it's all going wrong, before Oloni sets Khalil up on a series of first dates that will challenge him to turn him from a bad date to a good date. programme.title: My Mate's a Bad Date

Oloni reviews his dating past and gives him a cold, hard dose of reality as she and Dami watch some honest and sometimes surprising video feedback from family members, friends and even exes to show him where it’s all going wrong. Oloni sets Dami up on a series of first dates that will challenge him to shake off his bad habits and hopefully become a better dater. As Oloni and Larisa watch on, can Dami ditch the interrogation act, stop being so rude to his dates and actually stay to the end?

With four open cases counting against them, and police HQ breathing down their necks, the team are up against it. He then heads into the kitchen to see how that seasonal veg ends up on the players’ plates. Shetland is an archipelago of about 100 islands off the north east coast of Scotland, only around 15 of which are inhabited. It feels like they have entered a very different world - and it's full of surprises for both of them.

programme.desc: With the promise of unimaginable computing power, a global race for quantum supremacy is raging. Hannah Fry looks inside the IBM research facility, one of the oldest tech companies in the world, to uncover the future of quantum technology. She explores the unprecedented potential of quantum computing and how precarious this advanced power may be in the wrong hands. Through her exclusive interviews with world-class experts in quantum technologies, Hannah explores the international quantum arms race between the US and China. She breaks down the implications of this 21st-century race and how a quantum future could change the very nature of humanity.

programme.title: The Secret Genius of Modern Life
programme.desc: Hannah takes a look at the air fryer – a device that is rapidly taking over people's kitchens, cooking up everything from bread rolls to baked Alaska and almost making ovens obsolete. Hannah dives into its surprising history, going behind the scenes with air fryer originators Philips. She discovers how the accidental creation of a wonder wire in the 1900s, a WWII pilot’s cold dinner and one man tinkering in his garage created this modern marvel that is redefining cooking.

programme.desc: The team restore a Man Utd shirt worn by a Busby Babe in the FA Cup final, a Bible from a wartime internment camp, an ornate Punjabi hookah and a Bradford shop window automaton.

The film reveals, for the first time, the ‘David v Goliath’ battle as they search for answers and fight for justice for their children.

programme.desc: Sitting between Germany and France, Alsace is frontier land with a cuisine to match. In Strasbourg, Eva stops off at Brasserie Le Tigre for a beer (brassier means ‘to brew’) and a deliciously creamy tarte flambee. Then there's a trip to guide Coralie Andt’s restaurant, known as a winstub, where French wines can be enjoyed with plenty of cheese and sausage – as well as more sausage with sauerkraut cooked in white Riesling wine. With French tarts in a brasserie that serves German-style beer, and German sausage in a winstub serving French white wine, Alsace is defined by its competing national influences.

Natasha Raskin Sharp visits the workshop of cordwainer Payson Muller, originally a stonemason, who turned his talents to making bespoke shoes on hand-carved shoe lasts. He creates them from beech boughs before refining their shape using a knife and rasp. Hoping to cut a few deals of their own are two teams of bargain hunters, shopping for collectibles at Wetherby Racecourse. programme.desc: Humanity's very survival depends on water. But global reserves are rapidly shrinking with no end in sight thanks to unmitigated climate change, population growth and poor resource management. Over two-thirds of the global population are faced with water stress, while millions have already been displaced by intense water scarcity which is now replacing oil as the most likely cause of global conflict. Hannah Fry learns about the different ways in which technology could help secure humanity’s future water needs. She witnesses the effects of water scarcity in Kenya and learns about how technological solutions are currently being harnessed to reverse this dire situation.

programme.title: The Secret Genius of Modern Life
programme.desc: Fridges have been quietly ‘keeping things cool’ in the kitchen for over 100 years, and yet most of us barely give them a second thought. Hannah hits the production line with appliance giants Bosch to find the lifeblood at the heart of every fridge and gets a lesson in carrot droop. And she takes a long, cool look at the fridge’s history to reveal how a French monk with a flair for chemistry, a 17th century chicken incubator and an explosive invention in Australia created the ultimate chill.

programme.title: Monty Don’s British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don explores the most densely populated part of the country, London and the home counties. He visits some of London’s gardens, including a special one on a barge, as well as a beautifully restored garden close to where he grew up in Hampshire and some gardens known for their different and personal styles of planting.

programme.title: Rise of the Rockstar Chef

programme.title: Cunk on Cinema
programme.desc: Philomena Cunk’s groundbreaking history of cinema begins. Cunk meets Hollywood legends and interrogates the writer of Die Hard, as she starts her quest deep, deep into cinema. She witnesses the shockingly poor picture quality of the earliest films and marvels at the beards of their Victorian inventors; she gasps audibly at the invention of sound; and she critiques some of the supposedly finest creations of Hollywood’s Golden Age. Along the way she interviews filmmakers, actors and critics, including several you’ve definitely heard of, and she (and you) finally discovers the true meaning of The Wizard of Oz.

Hannah Fry looks inside the IBM research facility, one of the oldest tech companies in the world, to uncover the future of quantum technology. She explores the unprecedented potential of quantum computing and how precarious this advanced power may be in the wrong hands. Through her exclusive interviews with world-class experts in quantum technologies, Hannah explores the international quantum arms race between the US and China. She breaks down the implications of this 21st-century race and how a quantum future could change the very nature of humanity.

programme.title: John Simpson - 60 Years at the BBC
programme.desc: John Simpson looks back at his extraordinary 60-year career at the BBC - reporting on the biggest global stories of the era. In a frank, personal and revealing documentary, he reflects on the changing world he has witnessed: the revolution in Iran that seemed destined to fail, his brutal kidnapping in Beirut, the fall of the Berlin Wall, two wars in Iraq, the invasion of Afghanistan and a mind-altering trip up the Amazon. From the Broadcasting House newsroom in 1966 to World Affairs editor, he looks back at memorable encounters with inspiring leaders and cruel dictators - the figures who have shaped history, including Nelson Mandela, Margaret Thatcher, Saddam Hussein, Colonel Gaddafi and Volodymyr Zelensky. The programme also features his insights into the role of the BBC today and the challenges faced in the age of fake news.

programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are off to join Cynthia and the Nature Club at the park looking for animals that are hard to spot. JoJo has packed her Nature Tick Book and her magnifying glass. It’s time for a Gran Gran plan to help the Nature Club find all of the creatures on their lists, especially the hard-to-spot woodpecker. Can JoJo also help Gran Gran find her missing scarf with the magnifying glass?

programme.title: BeddyByes

Gramma Leeba tells the friends about their very full day.

Flop arrives, bringing his sleeping bag and Hoppity so they can all sleep over.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: There’s a girder out of place on Swoppiton Bridge, and unless Nori can fix it, that bridge is coming down! Luckily, Mojo’s got the tops, and Bo’s got the skills to help get it done.

programme.desc: The Squirrels see Duggee reading Wonderful Stories about Wise Animals and want to learn about wisdom and how they can become wiser. They find out that wisdom isn’t just about facts and figures, but that it's about good judgement and experiences too. They learn to plan ahead, concentrate on the task at hand, that sometimes big problems need a little help, to focus on the present and that good things come to those who wait. Thank goodness Duggee is so wise!

programme.desc: The Go Jetters are paddling down Malaysia's Selangor River in canoes to look at the region's fireflies. But after a bend in the river, they encounter Glitch attempting to chop down one of the protected mangrove trees, hoping to impress Tala with the rare plant. Although they manage to stop him, the approaching dark and some thick mud leave them in a tricky situation. Can the team work out how to light their way and find their friends?

programme.desc: Brown explains to Pale Yellow how the world around them changes colour as the seasons change.

programme.title: Love Monster

programme.title: Justin's House
programme.desc: Justin is very excited to show Robert his new robot. Justi is a voice-activated machine that can do anything! She’s an expert at tidying, dusting and even making super sticky buns! But this doesn't make Robert feel excited. He confides in Cat that he’s worried Justin won’t need him anymore as Justi can do all the things he can but better! Robert resolves to show Justin just how much he needs him.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Sula and Bing are camping in Bing's garden in order to see the stars and the moon. As Flop goes back for Hoppity, night-time noises seep from the dark garden, spooking Bing. Then, a scary shape on the tent terrifies him. They go inside, but the monster has followed them in! Bing and Sula discover that Flop is the monster. So they go back outside, where the billion, zillion stars and a huge moon are waiting for them.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘key’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different keys and explore how they look and what they do. We see a silver key, a locking key, a car key and a castle key. There’s a magic key, a fun key and Dee even loses her keys. Can you help her find them? The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Tralala
programme.desc: Pasilio loves to keep lost things, but Tralala knows they need to go back to their owners.

programme.title: MaeBee
programme.desc: At the Festival of Stars, King Gob sends Mae and Bee on a quest for a jewel for his crown - a star from the sky! But the Wisest Owl reveals that the quest may not be what it seems.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: When Small is feeling strangely unsatisfied, her grandparents suggest she paints more regularly.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos are in a hall where they watch a couple rehearsing a ballroom dance, accompanied by a piano player. He starts off playing slowly and speeds up towards the end of the dance, which gets quicker and more energetic. The Twirlywoos watch this with interest, and when the pianist steps out to take a break, they decide to investigate the piano. They start to play their own tune by running and jumping on the keys, and the dancers come in and start trying to dance to it. As the Twirlywoos get carried away, the tune gets faster and faster, and the dancers try frantically to keep up. The Hooter ends the performance by calling the Twirlywoos home, and the dancers fall in an exhausted heap on the floor! The Twirlywoos come back to the boat to find the Twirlywoo Screen. A red dot appears, and when Toodloo touches it, it makes a 'splat' sound. More dots appear, and the Twirlywoos splat them as quickly as they can. The dots appear faster and faster, and the Twirlywoos have to move faster to keep up with them. Eventually the whole Twirlywoo Screen is covered in brightly coloured splats, like an abstract painting.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin has lots of outdoor summer fun with his friends. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble judges the Best Kept Garden competition - will the award go to Aunt Polly or Grandad Tumble?

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po follow a trail of flowers that leads them to some very special treasure.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Marta, Hud, Theo, Isobel, Sehaj, Isaac and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their babies at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are teddy bears which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding baby appropriate teddy bears inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The fun song ‘Round and Round the Garden’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Baby Bear Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: I Spy, You Spy
programme.desc: Elsee joins her friend Karlaine to watch a rugby match and play a game of I-spy.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie, Triggs and Mum are about to watch a movie, but something smells funny and stops them in their tracks. It's Triggs's teddy - it needs a wash! Mum decides to put Triggs's beloved but smelly, squeaky teddy in the washing machine, but Triggs is terrified Teddy will be lost forever. Maddie must win his trust, because that teddy really stinks!

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: Rebecca has lost her healthy, fruity snacks. Murphi can’t find them either, but he does find a huge portrait of his great-grandma with the big eyes. This gives him an 'eye-dea' for a make – a pair of silly eyeglasses! The Mini Monsters make muffins, Rebecca gets a call on the Magic Monster Mirror from her aunt, and Murphi and Rebecca create a snack tube train with some support from the Tiny Helpers and the Recycling Express.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion
programme.desc: Stop-frame animated series featuring Raa Raa and his friends, who solve very noisy mysteries in the Jingly Jangly Jungle. Raa Raa and all his friends are finding out about different animals. Raa Raa wants to show Topsy his three favourite things. But when he gets to his friend's house, they have disappeared. Raa Raa and his friends set out on a noisy adventure to find the missing objects.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey's playgroup is at odds when Indy's baby hospital collides with Rusty's knights and dragons. But in explaining themselves, they both find that their games actually have a lot in common.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: After the Squirrels find out that knitting is one of Duggee’s favourite things to do, they ask him what it means to have a favourite thing. After Duggee explains that it’s something you like more than anything else, the Squirrels wonder what their favourite things are. To help them decide, they interview a few of their friends to find out what different things and activities are special to them. Some answers are predictable, some are surprising, and some even have more than one favourite thing... wait, you can have more than one favourite thing? Well in that case, why not have a list of top ten favourites! With a fun Top of the Pops-style countdown from ten to one, each Squirrel shows off some of the things that are most important to them. But what will come in at number one?

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Harrison wants to find out all about crane flies in today’s episode. Rory and Sandy head to a nature reserve to try to spot them, and Chantelle meets a bug expert in in his garden. Chantelle and Rory’s fact files help answer all of Harrison’s questions. With the help of the Teeny Tiny Creatures poem, we discover that, like lots of other teeny tiny creatures, crane flies are superheroes and help our planet in their own special way. In the Teeny Tiny Task, Rory, Sandy and Zoe make their legs grow with the help of some stilts, as they discover what it’s like having long legs like a crane fly!

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Magic is in the air as Mum has a wizarding surprise waiting for Iona and Elba in the garden. Later, the whole family head out to launch their kite in the windy sky – but will it take flight?

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Jen’s brought in her sticker album to show Small, and she wants to finish filling it. Jack from Jack and the Beanstalk comes to visit, Small flies off to find out how runner beans grow, and the two cooks rustle up a magic bean curry for their beanstalk-climbing guest.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Guide dog Kika uses her super sight to help Dr Amit and his friend Alana play a game of sound tennis. Kika tries not to chase the noisy balls at the sports centre.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie head into the dark to meet some Senegal bushbabies. These shy creatures are nocturnal and only come out at night. Using special cameras, we see that they have satellite-like ears that constantly move around, trying to pick up the slightest sounds of their favourite food – like bugs. Next, they meet two dwarf crocodiles. These tiny crocs are doing target training. When they nudge a coloured target, they get fed. Bushbabies and dwarf crocodiles are very different animals, but Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the unusual and extraordinary wild connection is between them.

programme.title: What’s in Your Bag?
programme.desc: Swimmer Maisie, a Paralympic gold medallist, tells us how her swimming cap helps her to go faster.

programme.title: Waffle's After School Club
programme.desc: Mrs Hobbs challenges the after schoolers to vote for their favourite activity - and to do it again on Mr Brooklyn-Bell's arrival.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Oona turns bird detective and learns all about seagull behaviour.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Yukee and TapTap try to track down the source of a strange chirping noise in the garden.

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: Declan learns that there are some things we just don’t know the answer to, but that’s OK.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Fiona wants to go on an adventure but can’t carry all her things. The Piggies turn her yurt into a flying Yurticopter so that she can take everything with her - but is it strong enough?

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: One of the bottles in Ten's collection accidentally falls off the wall, setting off a spectacular numbery hullabaloo. Learn to count down from ten by taking one away with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: J is convinced she's a jaybird - but she just can't seem to fly. V makes a van and soon they are on a musical road trip to find the friends who can help J reach for the sky. This episode introduces the letters J and V and the words van, jog, jig, jug, vet and jet.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Maddie meets twin brothers Aahil and Abdul, and they become explorers. They use binoculars, hunt for dinosaurs and uncover fossils. Mr Tumble does his best impression of a dinosaur. There's fun with puppets in this spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words binoculars, dinosaur and fossil.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: The Teletubbies have their favourite things and the Noo-noo wants to join in. When the Tubby Phone rings, the Teletubbies and the Noo-noo do the Tubby Phone dance together.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how dead wood plays an important role in the environment. They find out that even though the wood is no longer alive, dead wood is a home for animals, insects, birds and fungi, and learn that dead wood breaks down to give nutrients back to the soil. On the way, they have a game of tag by an upright dead tree called a snag!

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: In today's episode Maddie is finding out about different gates that open and close. She visits a canal lock to find out how canal boats travel up and down hill. Maddie jumps aboard with her special steady camera as the canal boat moves through a lock so we can see the gates in action. Next, Maddie visits a blacksmith's workshop to find out how a decorative steel gate is made. We see the pieces of steel being cut and welded together. Maddie uses a special thermal imagining camera to see the sparks fly, and how hot the metal becomes, when it is joined together.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies' very own motorbike rider, Grace, shows off three amazing machines that can go on both land and water. Grace goes for a ride on a quad bike that turns into a jet ski, shows off a vehicle that floats using its wheels and then drives a pond weed cutter!

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: It’s autumn time. Jud, Jessica and their class visit a local park to collect leaves for an art project. Back at school, they use the leaves to create a huge leaf print picture - and things end up getting messy! The school playground is covered in leaves and the school caretaker, Mr Clever, needs help clearing them up. Luckily, he has a team of super leaf sweepers, who come to the rescue.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Animated deep sea adventure series. Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. In search of a mythical sword, Kwazii explores a pirate shipwreck that happens to be guarded by three swashbuckling swordfish!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 opens in Joensuu, Finland in freezing -5°C conditions. Athletes battle frame carry as first event on ice and snow. Brian Kichton sets early pace, but Kevin Hazeleger ultimately wins with 27.57s. Competitors from USA, Finland, Turkey and others struggle with cold and debut performances, setting the tone for a global season. Cold conditions define the opening stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 Stage 2 in Riga, Latvia opens by the Baltic Sea with 12 athletes competing in spring conditions. Events include truck pull, log lift, bag toss medley, loading race and Atlas Stones. Home favourite Aivars Smaukstelis returns in emotional final Latvian appearance aiming for his third SCL crown. The competition begins with a truck pull opener setting early times.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 heads to Zrenjanin, Serbia for Stage 3, where elite athletes compete in a packed city-centre showdown. With four debutants joining established names like Evans Nana and Aivars Smaukstelis, competitors face brutal tests including a 16,000kg truck pull as the season builds momentum.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 kicks off in Crema, Italy, for Stage 4 of the season, bringing a world-class lineup to Lombardy. Athletes face brutal tests including car deadlift, log lift medley, Hercules hold, and Atlas stones, as reigning champion Rayno Nel returns fresh from major victory to defend his crown.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Netherlands, for a high-stakes summer showdown. A world-class lineup, including Rayno Nel, Brian Kichton, and Evans Nana, battles in extreme 35°C heat across six brutal events such as truck pull, Viking press, and Atlas stones, as the fight for SCL glory intensifies.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Holland, for Stage 5 as athletes resume Day 2 of competition in a tight battle for the SCL title. With only three events remaining, competitors face a brutal sandbag loading race and other heavy tests, as Kevin Hazeleger and Rayno Nel fight for the overall lead.

programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Esposende, Portugal, for the World’s Strongest Latino contest. Twelve elite athletes battle through a truck pull, deadlift, log lift, bag toss and medley in front of a packed crowd. Early leader Juan Ferrer sets the pace, as Invernizzi and others fight for top honours.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League makes its U.S. debut in Toledo, Ohio! In day 1 of 2, fourteen world-class athletes battle for the SCL USA title across four powerhouse events — including a Super Medley featuring a car push, Fingal’s Finger, and a stone-breaking challenge. Other highlights include the Front Hold with a whiskey barrel, a keg toss into water, and a gruelling 130,000 kg boat pull - capped off by an electrifying Guinness World Record attempt.
